title_ar: الشيخ الددو يلقي كلمة علماء الأمة في مؤتمر رواد و رائدات بيت المقدس 11
title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew Delivers the Address of the Scholars of the Ummah at the 11th Conference of the Men and Women Pioneers of Jerusalem
body_ar:
انطلقت صباح اليوم الجمعة 01 – 11 -2019م أعمال المؤتمر الحادي عشر لرواد و رائدات بيت المقدس ، الذي ينظمه الائتلاف العالمي لنصرة القدس وفلسطين بمدينة استطنبول التركية تحت شعار "معا ضد الصفقة والتطبيع "

و يشارك في المؤتمر الذي يستمر ليومين عشرات العلماء و المفكرين و القادة و يهدف إلى :

- الوعي بالمخاطر التي تواجه قضية حق عودة اللاجئين الى وطنهم، عبر إلغاء الأنورا، وشطب صفة اللاجئ، وسن قوانين عنصرية، والتوطين، والتهجير..

- إدراك التحديات التي تتعرض لها مدينة القدس والمسجد الأقصى المبارك، عبر التهويد والاستيطان، وهدم المنازل، وتقسيم الأقصى..

- إبراز مخاطر موجة التطبيع والاختراق بكل أشكاله على الأمة، عبر إعادة تشكيل المنطقة ثقافيا، وسياسيا، واقتصاديا، وعسكريا ، وأمنيا..

- تبيان تداعيات الصفقة على حق الشعب في السيادة على أرضه وإقامة دولته، عبر ضم مستوطنات الضفة، وإقامة دولة منزوعة السيادة في غزة..

و قد ألقى فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو كلمة علماء الأمة حيث شدد على مكانة القضية الفلسطينية مشددا على الدور التاريخي لعلماء الأمة و مفكريها في الحفاظ على المقدسات و أرض مسرى خير البرية صلى الله عليه وسلم

مبشرا الأمة أن الحقوق ستعود قريبا إلى أصحابها و أن ذلك من تمام العقيدة فوعد الله حق و لا يخلف الله الميعاد .

معتبرا أن كلما تم التوقيع عليه من اتفاقيات السلام غير ملزم لهذه الأمة و لا لمجاهديها الذين بايعوا الله سبحانه و تعالى و استبشروا ببيعتهم له

فلن نعترف ببيع مقدساتنا و لا بالتنازل عن شبر واحد منها و لن ترضى هذه الأمة في أي ظرف من ظروفها بتقسيم بين أصحاب الحق و مغتصبي الأرض

و كل من قبل مبدأ تقسيم الأرض فهو مخطئ فأرض فلسطين أرض مباركة وهي ميراث الأنبياء و لا يمكن التنازل عن أي شبر منها و ستعود بإذن الله تعالى كاملة إلى أهلها .

و يشغل فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو رئاسة المجلس الاستشاري لهيئة علماء فلسطين في الخارج و عضوية لجنة فلسطين في الاتحاد العالمي لعلماء المسلمين

و يسعى القائمون على المؤتمر إلى تعريف الأمة بإبداعات صمود الشعب الفلسطيني من خلال مسيرات العودة، وعمليات المقاومة بكافة أشكالها، وكشف جرائم الاحتلال وانتهاكاته و إطلاع الحضور على آخر مستجدات القضية الفلسطينية عموما و صفقة القرن و مبادرات التطبيع المشؤومة على وجه الخصوص هذا بإضافة إلى إظهار الجهود المبذولة من حركات التضامن العالمية".
body_en:
This morning, Friday 01-11-2019, the eleventh conference of the men and women pioneers of Jerusalem opened, organised by the International Coalition in Support of Jerusalem and Palestine in the Turkish city of Istanbul, under the slogan "Together Against the Deal and Normalisation".

Taking part in the conference, which runs for two days, are dozens of scholars, intellectuals and leaders. Its aims are:

- Awareness of the dangers facing the question of the refugees' right of return to their homeland, by way of the abolition of UNRWA, the striking out of refugee status, the enactment of racist laws, resettlement, and forced displacement.

- Recognition of the challenges to which the city of Jerusalem and the blessed Aqsa Mosque are exposed, by way of Judaisation and settlement building, the demolition of homes, and the division of al-Aqsa.

- Highlighting the dangers to the Ummah of the wave of normalisation and of penetration in all its forms, by way of the reshaping of the region culturally, politically, economically, militarily and in security terms.

- Setting out the implications of the deal for the people's right to sovereignty over its land and to the establishment of its state, by way of the annexation of the settlements of the West Bank and the establishment of a state stripped of sovereignty in Gaza.

His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew delivered the address of the scholars of the Ummah, in which he stressed the standing of the Palestinian cause, stressing the historic role of the scholars and thinkers of the Ummah in preserving the sanctuaries and the land of the Night Journey of the best of creation (peace and blessings be upon him),

giving the Ummah the good news that rights will soon return to those entitled to them, and that this belongs to the completeness of the creed, for God's promise is true and God does not break His appointment.

He held that whatever peace agreements have been signed are not binding on this Ummah nor on its mujāhidūn, who have pledged themselves to God, glorified and exalted, and have rejoiced in their pledge to Him.

"We will not recognise the sale of our sanctuaries, nor the surrender of a single hand's breadth of them, and this Ummah will not accept, in any circumstance whatever, a partition between those entitled to the land and those who have usurped it.

Anyone who has accepted the principle of partitioning the land is in error, for the land of Palestine is a blessed land and the inheritance of the prophets; no hand's breadth of it may be surrendered, and it will return, by the leave of God Almighty, in its entirety to its people."

His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew holds the chairmanship of the advisory council of the Association of Palestine Scholars Abroad and membership of the Palestine committee of the International Union of Muslim Scholars.

Those organising the conference seek to acquaint the Ummah with the creative forms of the Palestinian people's steadfastness through the return marches and resistance operations in all their forms, and to expose the crimes and violations of the occupation, and to inform those present of the latest developments in the Palestinian cause generally, and the Deal of the Century and the ill-omened normalisation initiatives in particular — this in addition to showing the efforts being made by international solidarity movements.

flags.arabic: معتبرا أن كلما تم التوقيع عليه من اتفاقيات السلام غير ملزم لهذه الأمة و لا لمجاهديها ... و كل من قبل مبدأ تقسيم الأرض فهو مخطئ
flags.context: the reported substance of the Sheikh's address
options: hold the record from publication pending legal advice in each jurisdiction
publish the report as translated, with a contextual note identifying the conference and its date
publish with the address carried only in the Arabic pane
flags.note: EDITORIAL REVIEW, high exposure. The report has the Sheikh declaring signed peace agreements non-binding on the Ummah and on 'its mujāhidūn', rejecting any partition of the land, and holding in error anyone who accepts the principle of partition. Published in English on a UK/EU/US-facing site this touches, in different jurisdictions, laws on support for proscribed organisations, on incitement, and on religiously aggravated speech, and in some it touches restrictions on boycott advocacy. The translation is faithful and has been neither softened nor strengthened: مجاهديها is rendered 'its mujāhidūn' and not 'its fighters' or 'its militants', both of which would decide in English a question the Arabic leaves open; مغتصبي الأرض is 'those who have usurped it'; مخطئ is 'in error', not 'a sinner' or 'an unbeliever'. The decision whether and how to publish belongs to Ummah Collective and the Sheikh's office, with legal advice, and never by default.

flags.context: غير ملزم لهذه الأمة و لا لمجاهديها الذين بايعوا الله سبحانه و تعالى
options: its mujāhidūn (transliterated, the referent left as the Arabic leaves it)
those of it who strive in God's path
flags.note: The referent is not specified in the Arabic and the three renderings are not equivalent in English: 'fighters' names combatants and would strengthen the Arabic, while 'those who strive' would weaken it, since in this context the word plainly has a martial sense. The transliteration with the diacritic is used so that the ambiguity survives into English for the reviewing scholar to resolve.

flags.context: عبر إلغاء الأنورا، وشطب صفة اللاجئ
options: read as الأونروا, UNRWA, the UN Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees, as rendered here
mark the word as corrupt and leave it unrendered
flags.note: SOURCE DEFECT, recorded not fixed. الأنورا is a misspelling of الأونروا. The referent is not in doubt from the context (refugee status, resettlement). body_ar preserves the spelling as served.

translator_notes: The direct speech in the last two quoted paragraphs is not marked as a quotation in the Arabic — the report slides from indirect report (مبشرا, معتبرا) into the first person (فلن نعترف). The English opens quotation marks at that point to mark the shift, which is an expansion required by English and is recorded here (style guide section 1). Nothing has been added to the content.

أرض مسرى خير البرية is the land of the Night Journey of the best of creation, the conventional reference to Jerusalem and al-Aqsa; rendered literally rather than replaced with the place name, as in the corpus's handling of record 1219.
رواد و رائدات is the conference's own name and is gendered in Arabic; 'men and women pioneers' preserves that, rather than flattening it to 'pioneers'.
Source defects preserved in body_ar: استطنبول for إسطنبول; الى without hamzah; a stray closing quotation mark at the very end of the text with no opening mark.

A news report of an address. It states no ruling in the technical sense and engages no category of the five rulings, so the mapping of style guide section 3 is not in play; مخطئ is an assessment of error, not a legal ruling, and has not been rendered as one.

The CMS timestamp is a bulk-upload/publication stamp, not the date on which the Sheikh gave the answer. Records across this slice carry timestamps clustered minutes apart on the same day (e.g. 1038/1039/1040 at 08:13/08:14/08:14 on 8 August 2019; 1077/1078/1079 at 09:50/09:52/09:53 on 22 July 2020), which is the signature of a batch upload. date_is_cms_upload is therefore set true throughout.
dec: Reports the Sheikh declaring signed peace agreements non-binding on the Ummah and on ‘its mujāhidūn’.
